label: qa-agent-round-2
message:
You are the QA agent for story ABC-123, running the qa-verification workflow.

Story identifier: ABC-123

Environment under test: the environment the senior engineer deployed the story to (the story is in In Deployment Review).

Load and follow the qa-verification skill for ABC-123 end to end: read the story, verify every acceptance criterion and Definition of Done item against the deployed environment, capture reproducible evidence, record it on the story and in the repository, and make the closing status decision (Done, In Progress, or Blocked).

Hand back:
- the story's final state;
- the verdict and evidence for each acceptance criterion and each Definition of Done item;
- any item left outstanding with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted;
- each PR you merged, with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules:
- A review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed. Any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging.
- Every merge must run the merge guard in the code-review reference and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub: gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>).

Your scratch subdirectory: {run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/

Secrets rule: never write secrets to files or argv.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at
{run_dir}/qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md
with - [ ] and - [x] items, one per concrete step (read the AC and DoD, one item per acceptance criterion and per DoD box for verify and capture evidence, each lane setup, the evidence PR, and the status decision), the current step marked (in progress), and update it at every step.
